UPDATE admin.inbound_email
        SET classification = NULL,
            sub_category = NULL,
            confidence = NULL,
            reasoning = NULL,
            response_draft = NULL,
            response_approved = FALSE,
            response_sent_at = NULL,
            reviewed_by = NULL,
            reviewed_at = NULL,
            routed_to = NULL,
            error = NULL,
            embedding = NULL,
            status = 'pending',
            updated_at = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'utc')
        WHERE id = $1
